name: Staff inspector lever (samples hours_behind_main from the served-sha-watch state and the console Pages lag; at level file or act, files one fix-main-red issue per behind episode with the failing Vercel build step quoted)

knobs.note: Not a knob: the box's harness checkout, where the console part reads origin/main's last console-ui commit (bin/pipeline-health.sh fetches it). Plumbing. NOT settable from the control plane.

Not a knob of this lane: the served-sha-watch lane's vercel.conf path (default $H/vercel.conf), read here so the inspector checks the same projects the watch checks. NOT settable from the control plane.
BH-5562: owner/repo the staff agents file into (the staff lane's knob; else HARNESS_REPO), read here as the fix-main-red filing repo. NOT settable from the control plane; set it in env/global.env.

BH-9419 test seam: epoch seconds used as the clock, only with HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 and only all-digit values. NOT settable from the control plane. The level, target, day cap, dry mode, quote lines, quote line chars, fresh window, per-run cap and issue list cap are settings rows (staff.inspector.level, .target, .file_max_day, .lever_dry_run, .quote_lines, .quote_line_chars, .fresh_min, .lever_max_run, .issue_list_max), not lane knobs.
BH-9419 test seam: 1 = load the insp_* functions and return before the run. NOT settable from the control plane.

BH-9419 test seam: the Cloudflare API base URL, honored only with HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. The fallback is https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4, the URL bin/pipeline-health.sh block 8c reads. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: bin/staff/inspector-lever.sh honors INSPECTOR_NOW and INSPECTOR_CF_BASE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
